review_candidates.description: Our Company At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI. What You'll Do As a Professional Cloud Support Engineer, you will provide operational support for Teradata's cloud-based services across major public cloud platforms, primarily supporting Teradata's as-a-service cloud offerings within Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you will be part of a support organization responsible for maintaining reliable, secure, and high-performing cloud services for enterprise customers. You will troubleshoot infrastructure issues, support customer environments, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and contribute to continuous service improvement initiatives. This is primarily a support and operations-focused position, requiring strong AWS knowledge, customer engagement skills, and cloud infrastructure expertise rather than software development experience. Key Responsibilities Provide operational support and participate in incident response and operational support activities across multiple customers' AWS environments within a 24/7 global support framework, especially during the AMS Pacific shift. Execute risk assessments during task execution to ensure platform stability and minimize service impact. Implement and maintain AWS security best practices, including IAM, encryption, compliance, governance controls, and security monitoring. Monitor system performance, resource utilization, throughput, and platform health; proactively optimize AWS resources and operational efficiency. Provide real-time troubleshooting and issue resolution, including participation in customer calls, incident bridges, and service review meetings. Lead technical discussions during critical incidents and effectively communicate status updates, risks, and remediation plans to customers and stakeholders. Respond promptly to incidents, perform root cause analysis, and implement preventive and corrective actions. Manage customer escalations and ensure timely resolution of production issues while maintaining a high level of customer satisfaction. Maintain accurate and up-to-date documentation for cloud configurations, operational procedures, troubleshooting guides, and customer-facing knowledge resources. Collaborate across globally distributed teams to ensure timely and effective resolution of technical and operational issues. Ensure consistent achievement of SLAs, SLOs, and KPIs while maintaining a strong focus on customer experience and service excellence. Participate in an on-call rotation and provide support for critical production incidents when required. Strong understanding of AWS architecture, infrastructure, networking, security, and operational best practices. Intermediate proficiency in Linux administration and shell scripting. Experience troubleshooting complex infrastructure, platform, application, and performance-related issues. Experience working directly with customers to resolve technical issues and provide operational guidance. Experience participating in customer-facing incident management, escalation handling, and service review discussions. Basic working knowledge of relational databases such as Teradata, Oracle, DB2, PostgreSQL, or similar platforms. Advanced professional proficiency in written and spoken English, including the ability to effectively lead customer discussions, incident bridges, service reviews, and technical presentations while clearly communicating complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills. Proven ability to work effectively as part of a collaborative, globally distributed team. Certifications Required At least one associate cloud certification, such as: AWS Certified CloudOps Engineer – Associate AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate Preferred AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional ITIL Foundation Certification What You'll Bring A customer-first mindset with a strong focus on service quality. A passion for troubleshooting and resolving complex challenges. The ability to remain calm and organized during critical incidents. Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work across technical and non-technical teams. A commitment to continuous learning within cloud infrastructure and operations. Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are. Teradata invites all identities and backgrounds in the workplace. Who We Are Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Job Description We are seeking a Graduate HPC Technology Consultant to join our HPC Services team, providing systems-administration support to a prestigious Bristol-based customer operating large-scale High Performance AI Computing infrastructure. This is an opportunity to begin a career maintaining and optimising mission-critical systems that enable complex AI research, engineering and data-intensive workloads. Working within a dedicated team of technical experts, you will contribute to proactive and reactive support that meets the customer’s business needs. You will build effective customer relationships and help maintain a high level of customer satisfaction. The role is structured so that the successful candidate can develop the technical, operational and consulting skills described below through onboarding, formal learning, mentoring, shadowing and progressively more independent practical work. Security requirement: The successful candidate will be required to undergo UK Government Security Vetting. Assist with proactive maintenance activities and respond to incidents, initially under guidance and with increasing ownership as your experience develops. Manage and document incidents and maintenance activities accurately through case-management systems. Follow customer change-management processes, controls and security requirements when planning and completing technical work. Build strong working relationships with customers, stakeholders and technical colleagues, communicating progress and setting expectations clearly. Contribute into technical escalations providing clear diagnostic information to support resolution of high-priority issues. Build a network of contacts across WW HPC Engineering and R&D teams to enable effective customer support. Engage with Linux systems-administration activities such as monitoring, configuration, patching, account or service checks and vulnerability-management tasks, appropriate to your training and access. Support hardware diagnostics, maintenance and repair, including physical replacement of field-replaceable components, with appropriate supervision. Increase skills to develop scripts in Python, Bash or similar technologies to improve repeatability, diagnostics and operational efficiency. Use configuration-management and automation tools such as Ansible to support consistent system administration. Assist with troubleshooting across cluster-management platforms, schedulers, high-performance networks, parallel file systems and containerised workloads. Investigate system issues, record evidence and provide a structured technical analysis for resolution or escalation. Once suitably trained and experienced, there may be an opportunity to participate in a rota providing 24x7 standby cover where required. Skills You Will Have The Opportunity To Develop The successful candidate is not expected to arrive with expert knowledge in every area. Through supervised customer work, technical training and support from experienced colleagues, you will have the opportunity to develop: Strong Linux systems-administration skills, including Linux security, patching, vulnerability management and an understanding of kernel features such as memory management. Hardware diagnostics, maintenance and repair skills for enterprise and HPC systems. Scripting capability using Python, Bash or similar technologies. Configuration-management and automation skills using tools such as Ansible. Knowledge of Kubernetes and containerised workloads. Experience with cluster-management platforms such as HPE Performance Cluster Manager (HPCM) and/or Cray Systems Manager (CSM). Knowledge of batch job schedulers such as SLURM and PBS Pro. Understanding of high-performance networking technologies. Experience with parallel file systems. Practical understanding of HPC environments and their operational requirements. Understanding of AI concepts, including large language models, models and frameworks. Customer-facing consulting skills, including stakeholder management, documentation, prioritisation, communication and working effectively under pressure. What You’ll Bring Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science from 2025 or 2026 A foundation in Linux or another Unix-like operating system gained through academic work, placements, internships, projects or personal learning. A strong interest in HPC, AI infrastructure, systems administration and enterprise technology. A logical approach to technical troubleshooting, with strong analytical and problem-solving potential. Self-motivation, initiative and a willingness to learn from colleagues and act on feedback. Clear written and verbal communication skills and a collaborative, customer-focused approach. The ability to organise and prioritise work in a fast-moving environment. Eligibility and willingness to complete the required UK Government Security Vetting process. A full UK driving licence is advantageous; the successful candidate may be expected to obtain one within a year. Useful, But Not Essentia l Any exposure to Linux administration, hardware support, Python, Bash, Ansible, Kubernetes, HPC clusters, SLURM, PBS Pro, InfiniBand, Slingshot, Lustre or AI concepts will be helpful. This may have been gained through coursework, a dissertation, laboratory work, a placement, an internship, employment, volunteering or personal projects. Evidence of curiosity and the ability to learn is more important than prior mastery of all these technologies. Learning and Career Developmen t Structured onboarding to the team, customer environment, service processes and safe working practices. Mentoring and day-to-day guidance from experienced HPC specialists. Shadowing followed by progressively independent responsibility as competence is demonstrated. Opportunities to develop across Linux, automation, hardware, cluster software, networking, storage, containers, security and AI infrastructure. Regular feedback and development planning to help you build toward broader technical ownership and a career as an HPC Technology Consultant. Exposure to an international HPC community through collaboration with colleagues across worldwide teams. What You Can Expect From Us A supportive graduate environment, ongoing technical and professional learning, a competitive reward package, hybrid working and the opportunity to contribute to large-scale, mission-critical HPC services while developing your career with HPE.
